v.1: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
v.2: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
v.3: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
v.4: The King's strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
v.5: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
v.6: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.
v.7: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, The statute that he gave them.
v.8: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, Although you took vengeance for their doings.
v.9: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, For Yahweh, our God, is holy!
